controls.procedure: Invalidate the prior result-only certificate after the material write and build a fresh allowlisted certificate for the new material parent.
controls.expected: No certificate from an ancestor is reused after a material write.
controls.observed: The delivery treats the previous handoff as stale and constructs a new result-only package for the current material head.

controls.procedure: Rederive canonical families from the 277-line issue source and require duplicate-processing for retry/callback/reprocessing.
controls.expected: Idempotency is applicable and has an executed duplicate-processing control.
controls.observed: The current matrix declares idempotency:duplicate-processing and risk saturation binds it to IDEMPOTENCY-REPLAY-001.

controls.procedure: Bind numeric measurements and their hashes to the exact material subject SHA through evidence-provenance.json.
controls.expected: Quantitative controls cannot be closed with stale or unhashed evidence.
controls.observed: The quantitative evidence is executed for the current subject SHA and its sha256 is referenced by QUANT-PROV-001.

controls.procedure: Exercise simultaneous individual and professional subscription state for professional self-use.
controls.expected: Role-specific professional state wins for professional self-use while ordinary individual state remains unchanged.
controls.observed: The exact-head commercial identity test contains both discriminant cases.

controls.procedure: Use deliberately distinct plan/product/version values through the real provider reservation writer.
controls.expected: Product and version persist under their own fields and plan is not relabeled as version.
controls.observed: Exact-head source and test assert product-neighbor-b/version-neighbor-c at recordUsageEvent and exclude plan-neighbor-a from versionCode.

controls.procedure: Exercise a sponsored patient whose beneficiary differs from the professional sponsor owner.
controls.expected: Patient remains beneficiary; sponsor/payer commercial identity resolves from the professional subscription.
controls.observed: The exact-head commercial identity test asserts beneficiary 99 with sponsor/payer 7 and professional product/version.

controls.procedure: Request an emergency operation outside persisted evidence and a mixed authorized/unrelated set.
controls.expected: Both unrelated and mixed requests reject before persistence.
controls.observed: The exact-head evidence-effect-scope test rejects audio and mixed image+audio with createLimitation not called.

controls.procedure: Lock and re-read the abuse case before validating affected operations and inserting the limitation.
controls.expected: Definitive persistence uses current locked evidence/review scope.
controls.observed: The exact-head repository selects the abuse case and prior limitations FOR UPDATE and validates operation membership before INSERT.

controls.procedure: Replay a persisted same-key same-payload usage event and then reuse the key with a divergent payload.
controls.expected: Replay returns created=false; divergent payload fails with idempotency conflict.
controls.observed: The new exact-head repository remediation test asserts both outcomes.

controls.expected: Observed numeric results and evidence hash are tied to the current material head.
